about: Free evidence for the five Nov 19 'worth a look' cards, read by hand on Nov 20, 2026 (eBay sold search in Chrome on skibidi; TCGplayer product pages). eBay rows: [sold day, price USD, title], last 30 days, ungraded searches. These are public eBay titles we read ourselves, not PkmnPrices data. 'checked' is the value Claude worked out from rows whose title names this exact printing and Near Mint.
